{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of 'revenue' as float
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any nulls or invalid values in 'revenue'
print("Revenue nulls:", sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())
print("Revenue invalid (non-numeric):")
print(sales_df[~sales_df['revenue'].astype(str).str.replace('.', '', 1).str.isdigit()])

# Check the structure of the data
print("\nData types:")
print(sales_df.dtypes)

print("\nValue counts for customer_segment:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

print("\nValue counts for channel:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nValue counts for status:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())"}
